lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15 - A. Listen and say. Then practise.

details: Listen and say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, clear sounds, and confident repetition.
“Did you know the weather was going to be like this today? I wish I’d watched the weather forecast so I’d have known.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15 - B. Ask and answer

details: Ask and answer gives students controlled practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for accurate counting, correct use of the question, clear answers and turn taking.
“A weather forecaster tells us what the weather is going to be. Can you be weather forecasters and tell each other the weather in all these different places?“

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.69 - A Look and write

details: Look and write tests students  ability to write a word correctly using given letter clues and visuals.
Look for word recognition skills when viewing the visual through their choice of word and neat handwriting in their books.
“Yo be good weather forecasters, you need to know all the weather words! Work out the phrase to say at the end of your forecast!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

details: Look and circle reinforces and tests comprehension by matching words to images.
Look for word recognition skills and neat circling in their books.
“Time to practise your forecasting skills! Make sure you choose the right words to say.”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.16 - Speaking Ask and answer. Then draw each city’s weather.

details: Ask and answer gives students controlled practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions. Draw reinforces comprehension as students show understanding through simple illustrations that match each written word.
Look for turn taking and correct and confident use of target structures as well as drawings that accurately represent each word.
“You’re now chief weather forecasters for the whole world! Can you describe the weather in each place?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (closed pairs): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (open pairs): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs
Read, listen and sing provides the opportunity to revisit the target structure and vocabulary in a song,  practising reading and listening skills.
Look for accurate reading as well as good pronunciation as students follow the lyrics and finally sing the song as a group.
“Wow! Well done children. You are brilliant at describing the weather. Sing the words with me!”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Sing): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video Song): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Diary:
